name: _flag-options.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  preferences/_flag-options.scss — option row iconography — flag canvas/img + split flag + option label/sub-label.
//  Imported by preferences.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

$_B_FLAG: 'flag';

// Icon inside an option button.
.pref-option-icon {
  font-size: to-rem($space-2xl);
  line-height: 1;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;

  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas:not(.is-fallback):not([style*='display: none'])) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
      display: none;
    }
  }

  // Show SVG images when WebGL canvas has fallback
  &:has(.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas.is-fallback) {
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-img,
    .#{$_B_FLAG}-split {
      display: block;
    }
  }
}

// Flag images & WebGL Canvas — SVG from local repo
.#{$_B_FLAG}-img {
  height: to-rem(44);
  width: auto;
  display: block;
  border-radius: to-rem(3);
  box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-hairline) to-rem($space-xs) rgba($color-black, 0.25);
}

// Flag WebGL canvas in the language options.
.#{$_B_FLAG}-canvas {
  height: to-rem(44);
  width: auto;
  display: block;
  border-radius: to-rem(3);
  box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-hairline) to-rem($space-xs) rgba($color-black, 0.25);
  pointer-events: none;
}

// Split flag: two country flags side by side with a thin dividing line
.flag-split {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0;
  position: relative;

  .flag-img {
    height: to-rem(44);
    width: to-rem(33); // force equal width so both flags share space evenly
    object-fit: cover;
    border-radius: 0;

    &:first-child {
      border-radius: to-rem(3) 0 0 to-rem(3);
      object-position: left center;
    }
    &:last-child {
      border-radius: 0 to-rem(3) to-rem(3) 0;
      object-position: right center;
    }
  }
}

// Option label text.
.pref-option-label {
  font-family: var(--font-primary);
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: to-rem(16);
}

// Option sub-label (locale name/description).
.pref-option-sub {
  font-size: to-rem(13);
  color: var(--text-muted);
}
